data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Avoid and go elsewhere](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6509e61abc9f39429011cc5c)
Avoid if you can. Astronimal shipping and delivery fees followed by delayed shipping times. Given the cost I'm also greatly disappointed in your lack of flexibility with order changes when orders have not yet been fulfilled. Beware -- from the moment you click purchase you are stuck even if delayed/not fulfilled. A 10% credit torward a FUTURE purchase was provided to ease the burden - clearly you're missing the point. There are plenty of other high end furtniture shops out there, do your research beforehand. I regret not doing mine.

September 5, 2023

* * *

3

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Sep 21, 2023

Hi Margaret,

We thank you for reaching out and we're terribly sorry to hear about your experience with us. We are currently backed up on some orders but we see most of your items have been shipped with the new ETA provided. Please know your business is very important to us and we hope you're happy with the items, you purchased. If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to support@luluandgeoorgia.com.
